channels_connection_config.name: channels_connection_config
channels_connection_config.value: ("channels"."type" = 'api' and "channels"."base_url" is not null and "channels"."credential_encrypted" is not null) or ("channels"."type" <> 'api' and "channels"."base_url" is null and "channels"."credential_encrypted" is null)

price_rules_context_shape.name: price_rules_context_shape
price_rules_context_shape.value: ("price_rules"."kind" in ('context', 'combined') and "price_rules"."context_min" is not null and "price_rules"."context_min" >= 0 and ("price_rules"."context_max" is null or "price_rules"."context_max" > "price_rules"."context_min")) or ("price_rules"."kind" in ('default', 'time') and "price_rules"."context_min" is null and "price_rules"."context_max" is null)

price_rules_time_shape.name: price_rules_time_shape
price_rules_time_shape.value: ("price_rules"."kind" in ('time', 'combined') and "price_rules"."weekdays_mask" is not null and "price_rules"."weekdays_mask" between 1 and 127 and "price_rules"."start_minute" is not null and "price_rules"."start_minute" >= 0 and "price_rules"."end_minute" is not null and "price_rules"."end_minute" <= 1440 and "price_rules"."end_minute" > "price_rules"."start_minute") or ("price_rules"."kind" in ('default', 'context') and "price_rules"."weekdays_mask" is null and "price_rules"."start_minute" is null and "price_rules"."end_minute" is null)

price_rules_search_prices_nonnegative.name: price_rules_search_prices_nonnegative
price_rules_search_prices_nonnegative.value: ("price_rules"."web_search_price_micros" is null or "price_rules"."web_search_price_micros" >= 0) and ("price_rules"."web_search_preview_price_micros" is null or "price_rules"."web_search_preview_price_micros" >= 0)

price_rules_prices_nonnegative.name: price_rules_prices_nonnegative
price_rules_prices_nonnegative.value: "price_rules"."input_price_micros" >= 0 and "price_rules"."output_price_micros" >= 0 and ("price_rules"."cache_read_price_micros" is null or "price_rules"."cache_read_price_micros" >= 0) and ("price_rules"."cache_write_price_micros" is null or "price_rules"."cache_write_price_micros" >= 0)

requests_billing_terminal_shape.name: requests_billing_terminal_shape
requests_billing_terminal_shape.value: not "requests"."billing_enabled" or ("requests"."status" = 'settled' and "requests"."charged_micros" is not null and "requests"."held_micros" = 0) or ("requests"."status" = 'released' and "requests"."charged_micros" = 0 and "requests"."held_micros" = 0) or ("requests"."status" in ('reserved', 'forwarding', 'settling', 'needs_review') and "requests"."charged_micros" is null)

wallet_ledger_event_shape.name: wallet_ledger_event_shape
wallet_ledger_event_shape.value:
("wallet_ledger"."kind" in ('adjustment', 'correction') and "wallet_ledger"."actor_id" is not null and "wallet_ledger"."balance_delta_micros" <> 0 and "wallet_ledger"."reserved_delta_micros" = 0)
    or ("wallet_ledger"."kind" = 'reserve' and "wallet_ledger"."request_id" is not null and "wallet_ledger"."balance_delta_micros" = 0 and "wallet_ledger"."reserved_delta_micros" > 0)
    or ("wallet_ledger"."kind" = 'release' and "wallet_ledger"."request_id" is not null and "wallet_ledger"."balance_delta_micros" = 0 and "wallet_ledger"."reserved_delta_micros" < 0)
    or ("wallet_ledger"."kind" = 'settlement' and "wallet_ledger"."request_id" is not null and "wallet_ledger"."balance_delta_micros" <= 0 and "wallet_ledger"."reserved_delta_micros" <= 0)
